component.name: Shagoff Commander
component.summary: Dual-pane file manager in the spirit of Total Commander

description.p: A dual-pane file manager in the spirit of Total Commander, built with libcosmic for the COSMIC desktop. Total Commander keys and layout: F3–F8, marking with Insert and Space, quick search, tabs, history and hotlist.

ul.li: Copy, move and delete with conflict answers, trash, clipboard shared with COSMIC Files
Archives as folders: zip, tar.gz / bz2 / xz / zst, 7z, with passwords
Built-in viewer for text, hex and images, with code pages
Find files and duplicates, compare and synchronize folders, compare files side by side
Network mounts through gvfs and clouds (OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, MEGA, Proton Drive and more) through rclone
Built-in terminal that follows the panel, command line, toolbar buttons, multi-rename

description.p: A file manager needs the whole system: this flatpak sees all files and runs programs (open with, terminals, mounts, clouds, the command line) on the host.

screenshot.caption: Classic look: toolbar, drive drop-down, two panels with tabs
Classic look in the light theme
Modern look: drive buttons, breadcrumbs, panels as cards

description.p: Pack (Alt+F5): «Add date to name» puts the current date and time before the archive's extension; the checkbox is remembered.
Flatpak: owner and group offer only what can be changed without root, a missing external viewer or editor is reported, a hung thumbnailer is stopped with its children.
The built-in terminal no longer doubles typed letters when the program is started from the menu.
The Changelog button in About opens it.
Help → Changelog and Check for updates; the Help menu grouped with icons.
New app ID io.github.shagovAlexei.cosmic-ext-shagoff-commander (COSMIC trademark policy); settings and tabs move over by themselves.
Flatpak: programs run on the host, the built-in terminal under script on a host pty.
